verdict_rule: REPRODUCIBLE requires one immutable, route-bound record linking a public search request and search-space digest, search-system revision and run id/timestamp, objective/budget/candidate count, selected rank and complete candidate payload, deterministic exporter revision, source/binary hashes, and correctness plus performance evidence. ATTESTED requires an immutable externally attributable equivalent with all route-binding and evidence hashes. Anything less is UNPROVEN. Promotion prose, hand-expanded route tables, test fixtures, and schema/tool source are not search provenance.
